summary: A UI action bus handler (subscribeById, subscribeByType, useAiClientActionById, useAiClientActionByType) that returns false is now reported as rejected-handler instead of ok; UiActionHandler may return boolean.
howTo: Return false (or throw) from a bus handler only when the action did not happen; return nothing or true when it did. A handler that returned false by accident now makes the model read 'declined'. An app that calls bus.dispatch(...) or dispatchToolResultUiActions itself without awaiting or catching it now gets an unhandled promise rejection (UiActionRejectedError, reason 'handler') when a handler returns false: add a .catch, as the SDK's entity chip click now does.
